## Bridger Aerospace Engages Perella Weinberg Partners to Explore Strategic Alternatives to Position the Company for Future Growth


November 23, 2026 8:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_fd6b69ab052c3d450e233a0a1507ceeb/bridgeraerospace/news/2026-11-23_Bridger_Aerospace_Engages_Perella_Weinberg_98.pdf)


### Board-led effort to review a range of alternatives to support future opportunities and long-term value creation


BELGRADE, Mont., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc. (“Bridger,” “Bridger Aerospace” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: BAER, BAERW), one of the nation’s leading aerial firefighting companies, today announced that its Board of Directors has engaged Perella Weinberg Partners as financial advisor to explore strategic alternatives, which could include a sale, merger or partnership to maximize shareholder value and attract new capital to position Bridger for future opportunities.


As outlined in its third quarter 2026 earnings release, Bridger is taking steps to right-size its business and refocus on core aerial services and higher-margin opportunities. The process will include a comprehensive review of strategic alternatives with the objective to evaluate opportunities that support long-term growth, better align the Company’s capital structure, and create long-term shareholder value.


“Bridger’s mission is simple: to protect lives, property, critical infrastructure, and the environment from wildfires and beyond,” said Sam Davis, President and Chief Executive Officer. “The Board is taking a proactive step to assess an array of alternatives to best position the Company for future growth and to create long-term shareholder value. We remain focused on improving profitability, strengthening our financial position and building on the aerial services capabilities our customers rely on.”


The Company has not established a timetable for completing the review. There can be no assurance that it will result in any transaction, partnerships, recapitalization, financing or other outcome. Bridger does not intend to comment further on the review unless it determines that disclosure is appropriate or required by law.


**About Bridger Aerospace**


Based in Belgrade, Montana, Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc. is one of the nation’s largest aerial firefighting companies. Bridger provides aerial firefighting and wildfire management services to federal and state government agencies, including the United States Forest Service, across the nation, as well as internationally. More information about Bridger Aerospace is available at https://www.bridgeraerospace.com.
